items.title: Home REIT targets expense reductions amid liquidation and lawsuit
items.summary: Home REIT has outlined plans to reduce its ongoing costs to between £2 million and £2.5 million per annum following its September liquidation.

items.title: Coversure launches specialist medical cannabis broker in Stevenage
items.summary: Coversure Network has established Cupican Insurance Brokers in Stevenage to address coverage gaps in the growing UK medical cannabis sector.

items.title: PwC appoints Nick Wilks as UK Insurance sector leader
items.summary: Nick Wilks takes over PwC's UK insurance practice from Alex Bertolotti, bringing over thirty years of industry experience to the role.

items.title: Lloyd's welcomes new syndicates and ownership changes ahead of Lime Street milestone
items.summary: Generali, Credeq and Zurich expand their footprint in the Lloyd's market as the institution prepares to celebrate 40 years at Lime Street.

items.title: Abundant capacity favours credit cedents at 1/1: Willis Re
items.summary: Willis Re reports that credit, surety and political risk reinsurers enter January 1 renewals with strong capital and softening conditions, though selectivity remains.

items.title: Few UK firms quantify disruption risk despite high losses, Aon finds
items.summary: Aon's new report reveals that while many UK businesses face severe disruption from supply chains, cyber incidents and business interruption, very few have formal plans or financial models in place.
